searchText: Hi, in https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-specs/blob/master/docs/participant/participant.md#signing-the-contributions ``` eth_address_to_identity(identity).encode() github_handle_to_identity(identity).encode() ``` maybe im missing something but i cant seem to find out how the eth address and github handle is converted to identity. could someone help me out on this? <CarlBeek> here’s that function definition: https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-specs/blob/master/docs/cryptography/contributionSigning.md#identity cool dappnode support! https://twitter.com/eduadiez/status/1623963202500304896?s=20 Hi guys i completed the KZG ceremony about 2 weeks ago or more, but cant find my contribution on the page now. Yeah its not showing there Heres the record. But when i put in my ethereum address its not there I think you pressed the "unlock with Github" button, not the "Unlock with Ethereum" button. Otherwise you Participant ID would've shown an address no? damnit.. damn!!!! would it work in the same way, would it be seen as attached to my eth address to? If you go through the process again, but this time used an Ethereum address, there's nothing linking your two contributions unless you use something like `mikew2479.eth` of course as in alot of protocols are using it to register multipliers for airdrops nope 😦 Are you sure if you mint on github its not traceable to your mainnet pass? <CarlBeek> nope, nothing linking your github and ethereum addresses. if you really want a POAP at the end, you'll need to contribute with an eth addy Damn ok. Wish they didnt have the github option <CarlBeek> this is why we deemphasized the GitHub option on ceremony.ethereum.org interesting. which ones have you heard of using it for airdrops? Have i still got time. Lens potentially using it as a multiplyer Theres speculation alot of them are the first open contribution period is open until March 13, then Special period (for grants), then again for Open contribution until 4844 is ready to go live Thank you! i've left my computer running it hopefully it works Should i just leave it running continuously or should stop and try every couple of hours, what is the best method? Run it when you would've been online anyway Don't leave your PC running just to stay in the lobby. Just wake up the next day and log in again.

excerpts.author: cheechyuan.eth
excerpts.content:
Hi, in https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-specs/blob/master/docs/participant/participant.md#signing-the-contributions

```
eth_address_to_identity(identity).encode()
github_handle_to_identity(identity).encode()
```

maybe im missing something but i cant seem to find out how the eth address and github handle is converted to identity. could someone help me out on this?
